calls.title: Discord + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales) presented a two-year renewal proposal for Discord, addressing their pain points around payment flexibility, staying under a $500k total deal threshold to avoid CFO review, and ensuring affordable per-user pricing (currently $405/user) despite tripling seat volume. Key participants included Jennifer Richardson and Nate B (both from Discord), who pushed for a steeper volume discount and flagged the year-two jump to $400k as problematic. Next steps: Discord will investigate reducing user counts to lower costs, GrowthBook will explore splitting invoices, and both parties will reconvene next week to discuss two options (unlimited at 600 users or a reduced-seat plan).
